description: This file defines the Gdpr model class for managing GDPR-related database operations within the OpenCart application. It includes methods to add, update, retrieve, and list GDPR records associated with a customer.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: A class representing GDPR database operations within the account model namespace.

methods.name: addGdpr
methods.description: Creates a new GDPR record in the database with specified code, email, and action.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an existing GDPR record identified by gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdpr
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its gdpr_id.

methods.name: getGdprByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a GDPR record by its unique code.

methods.name: getGdprsByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves all GDPR records associated with a specific email.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Lists GDPR records with a status of 'processing' (2) that are older than the gdpr limit days.
